topic_name: Ethnic Integration Policy (EIP) and SPR quota
question_template: For a household with citizenship {citizenship} and ethnic group {ethnic_group}, buying a resale flat in block {block}, {town}, do the EIP and SPR quotas allow the purchase?

overview.quote: When buying an HDB resale flat, you must ensure your household is within the EIP quota for the block and neighbourhood, and if applicable, the SPR quota as well.
